cross_verification.note: govt.lc's official non-immigrant visa service page states only '2 certified passport size photographs' as the photo requirement, referencing 'passport size' without restating a number. By cross-reference with lc-passport.json (confirmed 50mm×40mm / 5×4cm via the Saint Lucia consulate in Toronto), the DB's '4×5cm' for lc-visa is plausible but was not independently restated on the visa page itself, so size is left unverified here rather than asserted as confirmed for the visa document specifically.
